answer: A full squad of eight can fit at the Illini Union (12 seats), the Grainger Engineering Library (8 seats), and the Main Quad (20 seats). Espresso Royale only seats six, so it does not accommodate a full squad of eight. [2]

When you sign in with Google, Google sends QuadConnect four pieces of information: your name, your email address, a link to your profile picture, and your Google account number. This is all that QuadConnect receives from Google. [1]
The handbook does not cover whether QuadConnect is available as a phone app.
